g.text: Training | Offline features to an evaluated, versioned candidate
Layer 2 · KFP orchestrates five typed tasks; work runs in Pods, with mounted source and artifact paths.
Feast and DuckDB execute inside the load Pod. Redis is not the historical training source.
Feast entity frame: [machine_id, event_timestamp] labels export: [id, label]
Typed handoff: cohort → partitions → selection → verification → evaluation
Separate 60-day ML source; not training on the 100GB ingestion milestone.
Versioned pipeline: ml/kfp_versioned.py. Notebook-compatible kernel: ml/kfp_notebook.py.
Recorded serving pin 6 and retrained candidate 7 have distinct lifecycle states.
Candidate training does not automatically promote serving.

g.aria-label: Illustrative flow directions; not live telemetry

g.title: Evaluated model, lineage and data version
Gated Helm deployment and API switch
